method: Web search for properties at each overnight point. Property names, addresses and highway exits come from the sources listed. NOTHING here was checked for availability or price on these dates, and nothing is booked.

nights.riskNote: Good interstate cluster at I-20 exit 501 by the Tanger Outlets. The only real issue is the hour you arrive.
nights.action: Book ahead and tell them you are arriving after 22:00, so the room is held.

nights.riskNote: Large cluster where US-49 meets I-59, exits 67A and 67B. No shortage of rooms.
Only three properties at I-10 exit 258, all modest. If they are full there is nothing else close.
nights.action: Book this one early. If it falls through, Live Oak or Lake City are further east on I-10 and much better supplied.

primary.name: Best Western Plus Madison Inn
primary.note: 58 rooms, outdoor pool, the best of the three

nights.riskNote: Summerton has essentially one motel. Do not plan the night here.
nights.action: Sleep at Manning instead, I-95 exit 119. It is 11 miles further north, so it is forward progress, and it has several properties. Santee at exit 98 has the most choice but is 10 miles backwards.

primary.name: Manning, SC - exit 119
primary.where: 11 mi north of the planned stop
primary.note: Super 8, Days Inn and others; adds 11 mi to this day and takes 11 off the next

alternates.name: Santee, SC - exit 98
alternates.note: Hampton Inn, Tru by Hilton, Econo Lodge, Super 8, Travelodge - the biggest choice on this stretch

alternates.name: Days Inn by Wyndham Summerton
alternates.note: the only option actually in Summerton

nights.riskNote: Big Quantico-driven cluster at I-95 exit 143, right where the route stops.
nights.action: Book early anyway: this is the night before the night before Thanksgiving on the I-95 corridor.

nights.riskNote: The most expensive night by a wide margin, on the busiest travel day of the American year, in a city where parking is charged separately. Expect well above the $130-170 the budget assumes.
nights.action: Book this first, before anything else on the list. Check the overnight parking fee separately - it is usually $30-50 and is not in the room rate.

primary.name: Courtyard Jersey City Newport
primary.note: closest mid-price option to the Supercharger and the PATH to Manhattan

alternates.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Holland Tunnel

nights.charging: The Newport Centre Supercharger (30 Mall Drive West, 19 stalls) is only 72 kW and the garage charges for parking. Arrive with enough range that you are not depending on a fast fill here.

nights.riskNote: Thanksgiving Day. Rooms are usually easy, but most restaurants are shut.
nights.action: Sort dinner before you arrive. Book a hotel with a restaurant, or buy food earlier in the day.

primary.name: SpringHill Suites Pittsburgh SouthSide Works
primary.where: SouthSide Works, by the planned charger
primary.note: walkable district, though much of it will be closed on the day

alternates.name: Hyatt House Pittsburgh South Side
alternates.note: kitchens in the rooms, useful on a holiday

alternates.name: Holiday Inn Express Pittsburgh South Side

nights.riskNote: Large metro, wide choice. The planned last stop is on the west side near I-465 and Rockville Road.
nights.action: Pick a chain near I-70 west or the airport. Nothing here needs booking far ahead.

alternates.name: Downtown Indianapolis
alternates.note: better for dinner, slightly off the line

nights.riskNote: Fort Leonard Wood keeps a large hotel cluster here, all within a few miles of I-44.
nights.action: Easiest night of the trip. You also arrive before 17:00, so there is slack here if an earlier day runs long.

alternates.name: Comfort Inn St Robert / Fort Leonard Wood
